strings.en: I'll stand in for Raul as best I can.
That person's way of fighting is dangerous...
It moves differently from the/　Raftclans we've seen before...!
The black Raftclans.../　We can't let our guard down...!
To end the fight with the Fury...!
I have to stop that person, no matter what...
However strong/　Zee-Gadin may be, I won't despair.../　for the sake of those who accepted me.
Mizuho, let's gather data on their machines.
Those people are just like me...
That person is enjoying the chaos...
That machine has a lot of thrust./　Watch the relative speed and distance.
We should assume its mobility/　is higher than Vort's machine.
Yes. I'll stay on my guard.
I doubt that machine can hold out long like that.
Yes, its output must have limits too.
If we don't stop that person soon,/　the door will be taken...!
I have to predict/　Debudedabide's movement patterns...
I sense a deep darkness from Debudedabide...
You can't tell just by looking, but...
No life signs from the target!
I know, now isn't the time for that.
Crystal Dragoon locked./　Attacking with caution.
The greatest mystery of Skull Knight is...
Why it speaks in Kansai dialect...?
That wave is dangerous.../　Just like Dark Brain...
The answer you've reached is wrong...
So putting too much weight on/　efficiency is a problem too.
To be destroyed because of that...
Despinis,/　watch out for the Geios series.
Yes. I'll stay on my guard...!
I have to erase the malice...
If we don't purify it soon, the darkness will return...
I'll keep it in check/　and help Arieil...
If we don't move it out of there soon,/　Dark Brain will...
It's both a living thing and a machine...
Ugh...!/　I can't lose the Rescue that Raul/　and Fiona entrusted to me...!
Mizuho, Raji, are you all right?!
If this weren't the Rescue Frame,/　we might not have held out.
Ngh...!/　Mizuho, we're launching the Ex Fairy!
Yes, we won't go down that easily!
I mustn't be swallowed/　by that person's obsession...!
A-At this rate, the gate will be affected too...!
We can't let Crystal Dragoon/　have its way any longer...
Ngh...!/　H-How am I supposed to dodge that...!
There's always a point where you can evade./　Even against Debudedabide's attacks.
It lives up to its boast/　of being an Emperor Unit...!
Ugh...!/　So this is the power of Kadum Hakam...!
The Kaana Type did this much damage...!
Before all that swollen negativity/　calls forth the darkness...!
Rearranging evasion patterns in real time...!
Ngh... Raising the target's response priority.
Understood./　Leave damage control to us.
The right fire suppressant sprayer is broken!
Never mind the fighting,/　this will hinder our rescue operations.
Mizuho,/　let's activate the repair system.
Cleaning up the cabin will be a pain...
I can't let that person get near/　Raul or Fiona...!
Despinis, let's pull away/　from that Raftclans for now.
I can't give in to that person's ambition...!
It seems this isn't some pleasure trip/　to the front lines...!
Despinis,/　we can't spend any more time on this.
So it's a small Zemon Mortar/　in itself...!
E-Even if we correct the mistake,/　the XN-L...!
As expected, they're tough,/　the Geios series...!
Ngh...!/　We have to hold back the Raftclans...!
I'm sorry, I took a hit...
Damage check... This much is fine.
Right foreleg thruster slightly damaged.../　Thrust down 8%.
Upper container, right hatch damaged./　Let's purge it.
Despinis,/　don't play along with her stalling.
Seemingly whimsical, yet precise in aim...
I doubt this is all/　Zee-Gadin can do, but...
Using the gate's power like that/　is very dangerous...
I'm sorry, I couldn't dodge it.
My analysis was off too.../　Debudedabide is troublesome.
Crystal Dragoon's movements/　are getting faster...!
We have to deal with it...
...Skull Knight doesn't seem/　to be taking this seriously.
I wonder if that machine even has/　a concept of holding back...!
Let's correct our data on that machine.
I couldn't shake off the Raftclans...!
It can't be helped./　Its mobility is far beyond ours.
Updating the data on the Gadisword machine.
Let's not let/　the Lamaris get any closer.
If I move early, I can handle it.
I can't be hit by the power flowing from the door...!
Yes, I'll dodge the next one too.
As expected, it's not/　as fast as the Raftclans.
Let's hurry the analysis/　of the XN-L's attack patterns.
We know the Zovorg machines' capabilities, after all.
We can't afford to be caught in that barrage.
Something that big.../　can't make fine movements, it seems.
Even the Rescue can dodge that.
Without data from the other Raftclans,/　that would've been close.
Leave the rest to me, Touya.
At times like this, I have to be useful...
